name: client-mosaic-columns
purpose: Three featured success stories side by side: each column is a client's mark on a face painted in the client's own brand colour, over a one-line story that links to the case. It is a page section — the site places it from a `{ _id: 'client-mosaic-columns', props }` entry and binds `props` straight onto it — and it composes `section-module`, `frame-box` and `logo-wall`.
useWhen: When three stories deserve equal weight and their brands should colour the band.
avoidWhen: For a mixed mosaic of stories and marks → use `client-mosaic`.
related: logo-wall` — the single-mark wall each column's face is rendered with.
bestPractices: Exactly three cells; the grid is three columns from the large breakpoint.
brand.base` and `brand.glow` are the client's colours and may be any CSS colour; set `brand.ink` to `'dark'` when the face is light enough that the link text must be dark.

props.name: ariaLabel
props.doc: Accessible name of the list of stories.

props.name: linkLabel
props.doc: Label the mark face reveals on hover and the link's accessible name.

props.name: cells
props.doc: The stories, in order; each is `{ name, logo, href, story, brand, logoTreatment? }` where `brand` is `{ base, glow, ink? }` (CSS colours painting the face, `ink` `'dark'` or `'light'`) and `logoTreatment` is `'monochrome'`, `'knockout'` or `'as-is'`.

examples.name: Default
